description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a una movilidad segura en RD, a travs de mejores estndares de la infraestructura vial y la implementacin de medidas regulatorias prioritarias. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar la seguridad de la red vial principal del pas; (ii) mejorar la seguridad en los entornos escolares; y (iii) fortalecer la regulacin y fiscalizacin del transporte

The general objective of the program is to contribute to safe mobility in the Dominican Republic through improved road infrastructure standards and the implementation of priority regulatory measures. The specific objectives are: (i) to improve the safety of the country's main road network; (ii) to enhance safety in school environments; and (iii) to strengthen transportation regulation and oversight.
